title: ChatGPT for Mac Launches Computer History: Say Goodbye to Screenshot Records and Build Your Work Memory with System Events
excerpt: On August 13, OpenAI released a blog post introducing the Computer History feature as an optional update, replacing the previous Chronicle research preview. Thi
content_html:
On August 13, OpenAI released a blog post introducing the Computer History feature as an optional update, replacing the previous Chronicle research preview. This new feature brings activity memory and timeline support to the Mac version of the ChatGPT desktop application. Unlike Chronicle, which relied on screenshots to build a memory library, the new feature directly uses macOS accessibility features to record interaction events, including clicks, input, keyboard shortcuts, and app switching, converting user Mac activities into structured memories.

This mechanism allows ChatGPT and Codex to quickly generate work summaries or help users find recently viewed files without needing to re-explain the context each time. Essentially, OpenAI is upgrading the concept of "context" from being manually provided by users to being automatically accumulated by the system—understanding what you're doing, no longer relying on screenshots, but rather on real behavior traces at the operating system level.

Privacy Design: Local Storage for 48 Hours, Then Erased

In terms of privacy handling, Computer History automatically excludes private browsing activities, and interaction events are stored locally for up to 48 hours before being deleted after the server generates memories from them. Pure text memories are retained locally until the user manually deletes them. This "event cloud upload, original content destruction" design aims to strike a balance between enhanced capabilities and data minimization, addressing concerns about the previous screenshot method's excessive collection of screen content.

Currently, OpenAI only invites ChatGPT Pro, Business, and Enterprise subscribers to experience this feature. Business and Enterprise subscriptions require administrators to enable it first, allowing workspace members to use it. The feature is not available in the European Economic Area, Switzerland, and the UK initially, possibly due to stricter local data protection regulations. As AI assistants evolve from "conversational tools" to "understanding work partners," system-level memory features like Computer History may become a focal point in the next phase of competition—but user acceptance of "being recorded all the time" will determine whether it becomes a useful standard feature or another privacy pitfall.

content_html_zh:
8 月 13 日，OpenAI 发布了一篇博文，介绍了计算机历史功能作为可选更新，取代了之前的 Chronicle 研究预览。 这项新功能为 Mac 版本的 ChatGPT 桌面应用程序带来了活动内存和时间线支持。 与 Chronicle 依靠屏幕截图构建记忆库不同，新功能直接使用 macOS 辅助功能来记录交互事件，包括点击、输入、键盘快捷键和应用程序切换，将用户 Mac 活动转换为结构化记忆。

这种机制允许 ChatGPT 和 Codex 快速生成工作摘要或帮助用户查找最近查看的文件，而无需每次都重新解释上下文。 本质上，OpenAI正在将“上下文”的概念从用户手动提供升级为系统自动积累——理解你在做什么，不再依赖屏幕截图，而是依赖操作系统层面的真实行为轨迹。

隐私设计：本地存储48小时，然后擦除

在隐私处理方面，计算机历史记录会自动排除私人浏览活动，交互事件在本地存储长达48小时，然后在服务器从中生成记忆后删除。 纯文本内存会保留在本地，直到用户手动删除它们。 这种“事件云上传，原创内容销毁”的设计旨在在增强能力和数据最小化之间取得平衡，解决之前截图方式过度收集屏幕内容的担忧。

目前，OpenAI 仅邀请 ChatGPT Pro、Business 和 Enterprise 订阅者体验此功能。 商业和企业订阅需要管理员首先启用它，以允许工作区成员使用它。 该功能最初在欧洲经济区、瑞士和英国不可用，可能是由于当地数据保护法规更严格。 随着人工智能助手从“对话工具”发展到“理解工作伙伴”，像计算机历史这样的系统级记忆功能可能会成为下一阶段竞争的焦点，但用户对“一直被记录”的接受程度将决定它是否成为有用的标准功能或另一个隐私陷阱。
